description: Aggregates bookings and account balances (sum, avg, mom, yoy, cumulative, share, count) by period, cost center, account or category. Amounts are ledger amounts (sign_convention "ledger", see sign_convention_note): revenue and expense are both positive as booked, a negative value reduces the account. Sums are therefore not result figures; get_periodic_summaries and aggregate_pnl_by_cost_center return the result effect (revenue +, expense −). A group that contains revenue and expense accounts has mixes_revenue_and_expense=true, and the response adds a warning. With group_by=account every sub-account is its own group; the group key carries account, sub_account (null = none) and account_ref. totals.sum covers all periods in scope regardless of granularity. mom/yoy compare with the previous bucket inside the requested window; the calendar previous month comes from get_periodic_summaries with include_previous. Groups are paged via after_group and pagination.next_cursor. available_range gives the tenant's full data range; an empty page does not mean there is no data. scope.pnl_reconciled=true means each month was cross-checked against the P&L; a warning then names period, both amounts and the difference. With text_query, cost_centers or categories the result is a subset by design and not reconciled. With text_query, scope.text_match gives matched_sum, unfiltered_sum (same accounts, cost centers and months without the search term) and matched_share_pct.

accounts.description: Accounts as "8400" (main account, same as "8400/000") or "8400/130" (sub-account). Each entry matches exactly that variant ("8400" excludes "8400/130"); unknown accounts are rejected. This is the account_ref notation of get_all_accounts and of the compute_aggregates groups.

after_group.description: Pagination cursor: pagination.next_cursor of the previous call returns the next page of groups.

categories.description: Account categories, as in the category field of get_all_accounts.

cost_centers.description: Cost center numbers; get_cost_center_list maps names to numbers.

granularity.description: Time bucket of the returned figures: 'month' (default), 'quarter', 'year' or 'total'. The tool rolls the months up itself.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

periods.description: Months as YYYY-MM. The shorthands 'YYYY' and 'YYYY-Qn' (e.g. '2023', '2023-Q2') expand to exactly the months the tenant has data for. Omit for every available period.

share_denominator.description: Denominator of 'share': bookings of one category and/or of the given accounts. Default: the total of all included data.

accounts.description: Denominator accounts, "8400" or "8400/130"; exact variants like the accounts filter.

category.description: Category name whose total is the denominator.

text_query.description: Case-insensitive text filter on the booking text and reference, e.g. a customer or vendor name.

name: compute_aggregates
